extra.motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stays sitting on the attic floor with his hand at his mouth, then lowers the hand to his knee and blinks up at the bulb with a puzzled frown. Later he reaches sideways, picks up a vitamin tub from the heap and squints at the label, turning it slowly in his fingers. The bulb on its flex sways very slightly. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: plastic tubs rattling, floorboards creaking, the faint tick of the swaying bulb. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
extra.why: Flow returned nothing on the original in repeated tries; motion softened and still re-saved at 1280 wide (cause not confirmed)
